tldr: Neptune in Aries: imagination and idealism attach to action, courage, and new beginnings.
body: With Neptune in Aries, the collective dream turns toward initiative: what it means to start, to lead, and to fight for something believed in. Inspiration runs strong and the boundaries around action can blur.
gift: Inspired courage, visionary leadership, and ideals strong enough to start something real.
challenge: Crusades without plans, glamorized anger, and confusing the urge to act with a reason to act.
note: Composed (planet x sign, dignity-aware); refine from authored material.
